Scientific Hypothesis: The prevalence of non-native plants introduced via gardening varies significantly based on habitat type. This hypothesis is derived from the dataset 'invaded_niche_pathways.csv', where the variables 'n.gard' (prevalence of non-native plants introduced via gardening) and 'habitat' (habitat type) are analyzed. The chi-squared test results show a statistically significant association between these variables (chi-squared = 824.40, p-value ≈ 9.53e-141), indicating that the prevalence of non-native plants introduced via gardening is not uniform across different habitat types.
